suggestions: pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
convert an IN subquery to a semi-join
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
use explicit JOIN syntax instead of comma-separated FROM clause
optimized_sql:
SELECT f.d_year AS d_year, f.brand_id AS brand_id, f.brand AS brand, SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
           d.d_year AS d_year, i.i_brand_id AS brand_id, i.i_brand AS brand
    FROM date_dim d
    CROSS JOIN item i
    WHERE d.d_moy = 11 AND i.i_manufact_id = 816
) f ON f.date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk AND f.item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY f.d_year, f.brand_id, f.brand
ORDER BY f.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
